description: Envelope generator and VCA, after the EMS VCS3

params.text: Stages are attack, on, decay and off — a trapezoid, not an ADSR. Each runs from near zero to 10 seconds
The envelope, 0-10V, attenuated by the ENV knob; INV — its inverse
IN runs through the internal VCA to OUT, under the envelope and the SIGNAL knob
Loops the envelope, restarting it as the off stage ends

inputs.text: IN runs through the internal VCA to OUT, under the envelope and the SIGNAL knob

outputs.text: IN runs through the internal VCA to OUT, under the envelope and the SIGNAL knob
The envelope, 0-10V, attenuated by the ENV knob; INV — its inverse
A trigger when the cycle finishes

menu: Resume loop on load — an envelope that was looping when the patch was saved starts looping again when the patch is loaded
